title: Vitalik-inspired AI payment system can send expired deposits to its treasury
summary:
zkAPI offers an exit without server clearance, but challenged spending states, vault pauses and note expiry can constrain recovery.

content: A new AI payment system inspired by Vitalik Buterin features a zkAPI mechanism allowing exits without server clearance. title: Menos AI Raises $5.1m To Build AI Infrastructure For Institutional Investors
summary: Menos AI, an artificial intelligence platform for institutional investors, has raised $5.1 million in a pre-Series A funding round led by returning investor Copper Sky Capital, with participation from Alpha Square Group. content: Menos AI has successfully raised $5.1 million in a pre-Series A funding round. The artificial intelligence platform, which builds infrastructure for institutional investors, was backed by returning investor Copper Sky Capital alongside Alpha Square Group. This latest financial boost brings the startup's total capital raised to over $5 million, aiding its continued growth and development in the investment sector.
